text.body: arthasaṅgrahaḥ maṅgalācaraṇam vāsudevaṃ ramākāntaṃ natvā laugākṣibhāskaraḥ | kurute jaimininaye praveśāyārthasaṅgraham ||1|| tantrārambhakasūtrāvataraṇam atha paramakāruṇiko bhagavāñjaiminiḥ dharmavivekāya dvādaśalakṣaṇīṃ praṇinīya tatrādau dharmajijñāsāṃ sūtrayāmāsa - ‘athāto dharmajijñāsā' iti| atra ‘atha' śabdo vedādhyayanāntaryavacanaḥ| ‘ataḥ' śabdo hi vedādhyanasya dṛṣṭārthatvaṃ brūte | dharmavicāraśāstrasya āvaśyakatā ‘svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' ityadhyanavidhau, tadadhyayanārthajñānarūpadṛṣṭārthakatvena vyavasthāpanāt| tathā ca - vedādhyanānantaraṃ yato'rthajñānarūpadṛṣṭārthakaṃ tadadhyayanam, ato hetordharmasya jijñāsā ‘karttavyā' iti śeṣaḥ| jijñāsāpadasya vicāre lakṣaṇā| ato dharmavicāraśāstramidamārambhaṇīyamiti śāstrārambhasūtrārthaḥ| dharmalakṣaṇapraśnaḥ atha ko dharmaḥ ? kiṃ tasya lakṣaṇam ? iti cet, ucyate - yāgādireva dharmaḥ | tallakṣaṇam - vedapratipādyaḥ prayojanavadartho dharmaḥ | prayojane'tivyāptivāraṇāya prayojanavat iti | bhojanādāvativyāptivāraṇāya ‘vedapratipādyaḥ' iti | anarthaphalakatvādanarthabhūte śyenādāvativyāptivāraṇāya ‘arthaḥ' iti | vedasya dharmapratipādakatvam na ca ‘codanālakṣaṇo'rtho dharmaḥ' iti sautratallakṣaṇavirodhaḥ, codanāpadasya vidhirūpavedaikadeśaparatvāt iti vācyam | tatrāpi codanāśabdasya vedamātraparatvāt| vedasya sarvasya dharmatātparyatvena dharmapratipādakatvāt | sa ca yāgādiḥ ‘yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityādivākyena svargamuddiśya puruṣaṃ prati vidhīyate| tathā hi - ‘yajeta' ityatrāstyaṃśadvayam ‘yaji' dhātuḥ, pratyayaśca | pratyaye'pyastyaṃśadvayam ‘ākhyātatvaṃ', ‘liṅtvaṃ ca' | tatrākhyātatvaṃ daśalakārasādhāraṇam, liṅtvaṃ punarliṅmātre | bhāvanāvicāraḥ ubhābhyāmapyaṃśābhyāṃ bhāvanā eva ucyate | bhāvanālakṣaṇam - bhavituḥ bhavanānukūlo bhāvayituḥ vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ | sā dvidhā - ‘śābdībhāvanā', ‘ārthībhāvanā' ceti | śābdībhāvanā tatra puruṣapravṛtyanukūlo bhāvayituḥ vyāpāraviśeṣaḥ śābdībhāvanā | sa ca liṅaśenocyate | liṅśravaṇe ‘ayaṃ māṃ pravartayati', ‘matpravṛttyanukūlavyāpāravānayam' iti niyamena pratīteḥ| yadyasmācchabdānniyamataḥ pratīyate tattasya vācyam| yathā - ‘gāmānaya' ityasmin vākye gośabdasya ‘gotvam'| sa ca vyāpāraviśeṣo laukikavākye puruṣaniṣṭho'bhiprāyaviśeṣaḥ | vaidikavākye tu puruṣābhāvāt liṅgādiśabdaniṣṭha eva | ata eva śābdī bhāvanā iti vyavahriyate | sā ca bhāvanā aṃśatrayam apekṣate | sādhyaṃ sādhanam iti kartavyatāṃ ca | kiṃ bhāvayet ? kena bhāvayet ? kathaṃ bhāvayet ? iti | tatra sādhyākāṅkṣāyāṃ vakṣyamāṇāṃśatrayopetāṃ ārthībhāvanā sādhyatvena anveti ekapratyayagamyatvena samānābhidhānaśruteḥ | saṃkhyādīnāmekapratyayagamyatve'pyayogyatvāt na sādhyatvena anvayaḥ | sādhanākāṅkṣāyāṃ liṅādijñānaṃ karaṇatvena anveti | tasya ca karaṇatvaṃ na bhāvanotpādakatvena, tatpūrvamapi tasyāḥ śabde satvāt | kintu bhāvanā jñāpakatvena śabdabhāvanābhāvyanivartakatvena vā | iti kartavyatākāṅkṣāyāmarthavādajñāpyaprāśatyamitikartavyatātvena anveti | ārthībhāvanā prayojana icchājanitakriyāviṣayavyāpāra ārthībhāvanā | sā ca ākhyātatva aṃśena ucyate ākhyātasāmānyasya vyāpāravācitvāt | sāpyaṃśatrayam apekṣate | sādhyaṃ sādhanam iti kartavyatāṃ ca | kiṃ bhāvayet ? kena bhāvayet ? kathaṃ bhāvayet ? iti | tatra sādhyākāṅkṣāyāṃ svargādiphalaṃ sādhyatvena anveti | sādhanākāṅkṣāyāṃ yāgādiḥ karaṇatvena anveti | iti kartavyatākāṅkṣāyāṃ prayājādi aṅgajātamiti kartavyatātvena anveti | vedalakṣaṇavicāraḥ atha ko vedaḥ ? iti cet | ucyate - apauruṣeyaṃ vākyaṃ vedaḥ | sa ca vidhimantranāmadheyaniṣedhārthavādabhedāt pañcavidhaḥ | vidhimīmāṃsā tatra ajñātārthajñāpako vedabhāgo vidhiḥ | sa ca tādṛśaprayojanavat arthavidhānena arthavān yādṛśaṃ ca arthaṃ pramāṇāntareṇa aprāptaṃ vidhatte yathā - "agnihotraṃ juhuyātsvargakāma" iti vidhiḥ mānāntareṇa aprāptaṃ svargaprayojanavad homaṃ vidhatte agnihotrahomena svargaṃ bhāvayet iti vākyārthabodhaḥ | yatra karma mānāntareṇa prāptaṃ tatra taduddeśena guṇamātraṃ vidhatte - yathā "dadhnā juhoti" ityatra homasya agnihotraṃ juhuyāt ityanena prāptatvāt homoddeśena dadhimātravidhānaṃ ‘dadhnā homaṃ bhāvayet' iti | yatra tu ubhayam aprāptaṃ tatra viśiṣṭaṃ vidhatte - yathā " somena yajet" ityatra somayāgayoḥ aprāptatvāt somaviśiṣṭayāgavidhānam | somapade matvarthalakṣaṇayā somavatā yāgena iṣṭaṃ bhāvayet iti vākyarthabodhaḥ | vākyabhedadoṣaparihāraḥ na ca ubhayavidhāne vākyabhedaḥ, pratyekam ubhayasya vidhānāt, kintu viśiṣṭasyaiva vidhānāt | guṇavidhyādibhedaḥ na ca "jyotiṣṭomena svargakāmo yajet " iti vidhiprāptayāgoddeśena somarūpaguṇavidhānameva astu , somena yāgaṃ bhāvayediti kiṃ matvarthalakṣaṇayā iti vācyam | tasya adhikāravidhitvena utpattividhitvena asaṃbhavāt | ubhayavidhitvam nanu "udbhidā yajeta paśukāma" ityasyeva jyotiṣṭomena ityasya utpatyadhikāravidhitvam astu iti cet, na | dṛṣṭānte utpattivākyāntarābhāvena anyathā anupapattyā tathātvāśrayaṇāt | kiñca jyotiṣṭomena ityasya ubhayavidhitve anenaiva yāgastasya phalasambandho'pi bodhanīya iti sudṛḍho vākyabhedaḥ | tadvaraṃ somapade matvarthalakṣaṇayā viśiṣṭavidhānam | vidhiścaturvidhaḥ vidhiścaturvidhaḥ - utpattividhiḥ viniyogavidhiḥ adhikāravidhiḥ prayogavidhiśceti | utpattividhiḥ karmasvarūpamātrabodhako vidhiḥ utpattividhiḥ | yathā - "agnihotraṃ juhoti" iti | atra ca vidhau karmaṇaḥ karaṇatvena anvayaḥ, agnihotrahomena īṣṭaṃ bhāvayet iti | yāgasya rūpadvayam nanu yāgasya dve rūpe dravyaṃ devatā ca | tathā ca rūpāśravaṇe'gnihotraṃ juhotīti kathamutpattividhiḥ ? agnihotraśabdasya tu tatprakhyanyāyena nāmadheyatvāditi cet | na | rūpāśravaṇe'pyasyotpattividhitvāt | anyathā rūpaśravaṇāt 'dadhnā juhoti' ityayamevotpattividhiḥ syāt | tathā ca 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' iti vākyamanarthakaṃ syāt | viniyogavidhiḥ aṅgapradhānasaṃbandhabodhako vidhirviniyogavidhiḥ | yathā 'dadhnā jahoti' iti | sa hi tṛtayiyā pratipannāṅgabhāvasya dadhno homasaṃbandhaṃ vidhatte - dadhnā homaṃ bhāvayediti | guṇavidhau ca dhātvarthasya sādhyatvenānvayaḥ | kvacidāśrayatvenāpi, yathā - ‘dadhnendriyakāmasya juhuyāt' ityatra dadhikaraṇatvenendriyaṃ bhāvayet| tacca kiṃniṣṭhamityākāṅkṣāyāṃ sannidhiprāptahoma āśrayatvenānveti || viniyogavidheḥ sahakāribhūtāni śrutyādiṣaṭpramāṇāni etasya vidheḥ sahakāribhūtāni ṣaṭpramāṇāni -- śruti - liṅag - vākya - prakaraṇa - sthāna - samākhyārūpāṇi | etatsahakṛtenānena vidhināṅagatvaṃ paroddeśapravṛttakṛṛtisādhyatvarūpaṃ pārārthyāparaparyāyaṃ jñāpyate | śrutinirvacanam tatra nirapekṣo ravaḥ śrutiḥ | sā ca trividhā - vidhātrī, abhidhātrī, viniyoktrī ca | tatrādyā liṅādyātmikā dvitīyā vrīhyādiśrutiḥ | yasya ca śabdasya dhavaṇādeva saṃvandhaḥ pratīyate sā viniyoktrī| viniyoktrī śrutistridhā sāpi trividhā - vibhaktirūpā, ekābhidhānarūpā, ekapadarūpā ceti| tatra vibhaktiśrutyā aṅgatvam, yathā - 'brīhibhiyajeta' iti tṛtīyāśrutyā vrīhīṇāṃ yāgāṅgatvam | tadapi puroḍāśaprakṛtitayā | yathā - paśorhṛdayādirūpahaviḥ prakṛtitayā yāgāṅgatvama | tṛtīyāvibhaktirūpāya udāharaṇam 'aruṇayā ekahāyanyā gavā somaṃ krīṇāti' ityasmin vākye āruṇyasyāpi tṛtīyāśrutyā krayāṅgatvam | tadapi gorūpadravyaparicchedadvārā, natu sākṣāt, amūrtatvāt | dvitīyārūpāyā viniyoktryā udāharaṇam 'vrīhīn prokṣati iti prokṣaṇasya vrīhyiṅgadatvaṃ dvitīyāśrutyā | tacca prokṣaṇaṃ na vrīhīsvarūpārtham, tasya tena vināpyupapatteḥ | kiṃtvapūrvasādhanatvaprayuktam | vrīhīnaprokṣya yāgānaṣṭhāne pūrvānupapatteḥ | evaṃ sarveṭeṣvaṅgaṣvapūrvaprayuktamahatva bodhyam | evaṃ 'imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasyetyaśvābhidhānīmādatte' ityatra dvitīyayātrutyā mantrasyāśvābhidhānyaṅgatvam| saptamīvibhaktiviniyoktryā udāharaṇam 'yadāhavanīye juhoti' ityāhavanayisya homāṅgatvaṃ saptamīśrutyā | evamanyo'pi vibhaktidyunyā viniyogo jñeyaḥ | ekābhidhānaśrutiḥ 'paśunā yajeta' ityatraikatvapuṃstvayoḥ samānābhidhānaśrutyā kārakāṅgatvam| ekapadaśrutiḥ| yajata' ityākhyātābhihitasaṃkhyāyā bhāvanāṅgatvaṃ samānābhidhānaśruteḥ, ekapadaśrutthā ca yāgāṅgatvam | amūrtayā api bhāvanaṅgatvam na cāmūrtayāstasyāḥ kathaṃ bhāvanāṅgatvamiti vācyam | kartṛparicchedadvārā tadupapatteḥ | bhāvanaiva ākhyātavācyā kartāramākṣipati| kartā cāścepalabhyaḥ | ākhyāte na hi bhāvanocyate | sā ca kartāraṃ vinānupapanneti tamākṣipati| śrutiḥ seyaṃ śrutirliṅgādibhyaḥ prabalā| liṅgādiṣu na pratyakṣo viniyojakaḥ śabdo'sti, kiṃtu kalpyaḥ | yāvacca tairviniyojakaśabdaḥ kalpyate, tāvatpratyakṣayā śrutyā viniyogasya kṛtatvena teṣāṃ kalpakatvaśakteāhatatvāt | ata evainyā liṅgānnendropasthānārthatvam| kiṃtu aindrayā gārhapatyamupatiṣṭhate' ityatra gārhapatyamiti dvitīyāśrutyā gārhapatyopasthānārthatvama| liṅganirvacanam śabdamāmarthyaṃ liṅgam | yathāhuḥ – 'sāmarthyaṃ sarvaśabdānāṃ (bhāvānā) liṅgamityabhidhayite' iti| sāmarthya rūḍhireva | tena samākhyāto'syā bhedaḥ, yaugikaśabdasamākhyāto rūḍhyātmakaliṅgaśabdasya bhinnatvāt | tena 'barhidevasadanaṃ dāmi' iti mantrasya kuśalavanāṅgatvaṃ, na tūlapādilavanāṅgatvam | tasya 'barhirdāmi iti liṅgāttallavanaṃ prakāśayituṃ samarthatvāt| evamanyatrāpi liṅgādviniyogo druṣṭavyaḥ | liṅgaṃ vākyādibhyo balavat tadidaṃ liṅgaṃ vākyādibhyo balavat | ata eva ‘syonaṃ te sadanaṃ kṛṇomi iti mantrasya puroḍāśasadanakaraṇāṅgatvaṃ 'sadanaṃ kṛṇomi' iti ligāt, na tu vākyāt || vākyanirvacanam samabhivyāhāro vākyam | samabhivyāhāraśca sādhyatvādivācakadvitīyādyabhāve 'pi | vastutaḥ śeṣaśeṣivācakapadayoḥ sahoccāraṇam | yathā 'yasya parṇamayī juhūrbhavati | na sa pāpaṃ ślokaṃ śṛṇoti' iti | atra parṇatājuhvoḥ samabhivyāhārādeva parṇatāyā juhvaṅgatvam | nacānarthakyam| anyathāpi juhvāḥ siddhatvāditi vācyam | juhūśabdena tatsādhyāpūrvalakṣaṇāt | tathā ca vākyārthaḥ - parṇatayāvattahavirdhāraṇadvārā juhvapūrvaṃ bhāvayediti | evaṃ ca pārṇatayā yadi jahūḥ kriyate, tadaiva tatsādhyamapūrvaṃ bhavati, nānyatheti gamyate - iti na parṇatāyā vaiyarthyam| 'avattahavirdhāraṇadvārā iti cāvaśyaṃ vaktavyam, anyathā nuvādiṣvapi parṇatāpatteḥ | seyaṃ parṇatā anārabhyādhotāpi sarvaprakratiṣvevānveti, na vikṛtiṣu | tatra codakenāpi tatprāptisaṃbhavātpaunaruktyāpatteḥ | prakṛtivikṛtilakṣaṇam yatra samagrāṅgopadeśaḥ sā prakṛtiḥ, yathā - daśaparṇamāsādiḥ | tatprakaraṇe sarvāṅgapāṭhāt | yatra na sarvāṅgopadeśaḥ sā vikṛtiḥ | yathā - sauryādiḥ | tatra katipayāṅgānāmatideśena prāptatvāt | anārabhyavidhiḥ samānyavidhiḥ| vākyaṃ prakaraṇādibhyo balavat tadidaṃ vākyaṃ prakaraṇādibhyo balavat | ata evendrāgnī idaṃ havi - ityāderekavākyatvāddarśāṅgatvaṃ, na tu prakaraṇāddarśapūrṇamāmāṅgatvam || prakaraṇanirūpaṇam ubhayākāṅkṣā prakaraṇam | yathā prayājādiṣu samidho yajatī' - ityādivākye phalāviśeṣasyānirdeśāt ‘samidyāgena bhāvayediti bodhānantaraṃ 'kimiti' upakāryākāṅkṣā | darśapūrṇamāsavākye'pi 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ svargaṃ bhāvayediti bodhānantara 'katham" ityapakārakākāṅkṣā | itthaṃ cobhayākāṅkṣayā prayājādīnāṃ darśapūrṇamāsāṅgatvam| prakaraṇadvaividhyam tacca prakaraṇaṃ dvividham - mahāprakaraṇam, avāntaraprakaraṇaṃ ceti | mahāprakaraṇam tatra mukhyayabhāyanāsaṃbandhiprakarāṃ mahāprakaragām | tena ca prayājādīnāṃ darśapūrṇamāsāṅgatvam | etacca prakratāvaba, ubhayākāṅkṣāyāḥ saṃbhavāt, na tu vikṛtau | tatra 'prakṛtivadvikṛtiḥ kartavya' ityatideśena kathabhāvākāṅkṣāyā upaśamenāpūrvāṅgānāmapyubhayākāṅkṣayā viniyogāsaṃbhavāta| tasmādapūrvāṅgānāṃ sthānādeva vikṛtyarśatvamiti | avāntaraprakaraṇam| aṅgabhāvanāsaṃbandhiprakaraṇamavāntaraprakaraṇam | tena cābhikramaṇādīnāṃ prayājādyaṅgatvama | tacca sandaśenaiva jñāyate | tadabhāve cāviśeṣāt sarveṣāṃ phalabhāvanākathaṃbhāvena grahaṇaprasaṅgena pradhānāṅgatvāpatteḥ | saṃdaṃśalakṣaṇam ekāṅgānuvāḍhena vidhīyamānayoraṅgayorantarāle vihitatvaṃ saṃdaṃśaḥ | yathā abhikramaṇe | tad hi, 'samānayate juhvām upabhṛtastejo vai' ityādinā prayājānuvāṭena kiṃcidaṅgaṃ vidhāya, vidhīyate – 'yesyaivaṃ viduṣaḥ prayājā ijyante praibhyo lokebhyo bhrātṛvyān nudate, abhikrāmaṃ juhotyabhijityai' iti tadanantaramapi 'yo vai prayājānāṃ mithunaṃ veda' (tatraiva) ityādinā kiṃcidaṅga vidhīyate| ataḥ prayājāṅgamadhye vihitamabhikramaṇaṃ tadaṅgam | prayājairapūrvaṃ kṛtvā yāgopakāraṃ bhāvayediti jñāte ‘kathamebhirapūrvaṃ kartavyam' iti karthabhāvākāṅkṣāyāḥ sattvāt | sā ca saṃdaṃśapaṭhitairabhikramaṇādibhiḥ śāmyati | na cāṅgabhāvanāyāḥ kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣā'bhāvaḥ, bhāvanāsāmānyena tatrāpi tatsaṃbhavāt| prakaraṇaṃ kriyāṇāmeva sākṣādaṅgatvabodhakam tadidaṃ prakaraṇaṃ kriyāyā eva sākṣādviniyojaka, dravyaguṇayaustu tadvārā | tathāhi - 'yajeta svargakāmaḥ ityatra phalabhāvanāyāṃ kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣāyāṃ saṃnidhipaṭhitāṃdhūyamāṇaphalakaṃ kriyājātamupakāryākāṅkṣayetikartavyatātvenānveti | kriyāyā eva loke kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣāyāmanvayaḍharśanāt | na hi hastena 'kuṭhāreṇa cchindyāt' ityatra kathaṃbhāvākāṅkṣāyāmuccāryamāṇo'pi hasto'nveti, kiṃ tu hastenodyamya nipātyeti udyamananipātane eva, hastaśca taddvāraivānvetoti sārvajanīnametat | prakaraṇaṃ sthānasamākhyābhyāṃ balavat idaṃ ca sthānādibhyo balavat | ata eva 'akṣairdīvyati, rājanyaṃ jināti iti videvanādayo dharmā abhipecanīyasaṃnidhau paṭhitā api sthānānna tadaṅga, kiṃ tu prakaraṇādrājasūyāṅgamiti || sthānanirūpaṇam deśasāmānya sthānam | tadvividham - pāṭhasādeśyamanuṣṭhānasādeśyaṃ ceti | sthānaṃ, kramaścetyanarthāntaram | pāṭhasādeśyamapi dvividham - yathāsaṃkhyapāṭhaḥ, sannidhipāṭhaśceti | yathāsaṃkhyapāṭhena viniyogaḥ tatra 'aindrāgnamekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet', 'vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapet' ityevaṃ kramavihiteṣu 'indrāgnī roca divaḥ' - ityādīnāṃ yājyānuvākyāmantrāṇāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prathamasya prathama, dvitīyasya dvitīyamityevaṃrūpo viniyogo yathāsaṃkhyapāṭhāt | prathamapaṭhitamantrasya hi kaimarthyākāṃkṣāyāṃ prathamato vihitaṃ karmaiva prathamamupatiṣṭhate, samānadeśatvāt | evaṃ dvitīyamantrasyāpi| saṃnidhipāṭhena viniyogaḥ vaikṛtāṅgānāṃ prākṛtāṅgānuvādena vihitānāṃ saṃdaṃśā'patitānāṃ vikṛtyarthatvaṃ sannidhipāṭhāt | yathā - āmanahomānām | teṣāṃ hi kaimarthyākāṅkṣāyāṃ phalaṃ vikṛtyapūrvameva ata eva śundhanamantraḥ sānnāyyapātrāṅgaṃ pāṭhasādeśyāt, natu 'pauroḍāśika miti samākhyayā puroḍāśamācāṅgam || samākhyānirūpaṇam samākhyā yaugikaḥ śabdaḥ | sā ca dvividhā - 'vaidikī', 'laukikī' ca | 'āśrayikarma ityucyate| ārādupakārakāṇi dravyādyanuddiśya kevalaṃ vidhīyamānaṃ karma ārādupakārakam | yathā - prayājādi | tayorviśeṣaḥ ārādu pakārakaṃ ca paramāpūrvotpattāvevopayūjyate | sannipatyopakārakaṃ tu dravyadevatāsaṃskāradvārā yāgasvarūpa'pyupayujyate | tadevaṃ nirūpitaḥ saṅkṣapato viniyogavidhiḥ|| prayogavidhiḥ prayogaprāśubhāvabodhako vidhiḥ prayogavidhiḥ | sa cāṅgavākyaikavākyatāpannaḥ pradhānavidhireva | sa hi sāṅgaṃ pradhānamanuṣṭhāpayanvilambe pramāṇābhāvādavilambāparaparyāyaṃ prayogaprāśubhāvaṃ vidhatte| na ca - tadavilambe'pi pramāṇābhāvaḥ - iti vācyam | vilambe hi aṅgapradhānavidhyekavākyatāvagatatatsāhityānupapattiḥ| vilambena kriyamāṇayoḥ padārthayoḥ 'idamanena saha kṛtam' iti sāhityavyavahārābhāvāt| sa cāvilambo niyate krame āśrīyamāṇe bhavati | anyathā hi - kimetadanantarametatkartavyam etadanantaraṃ vā ? iti prayogavikṣepāpatteḥ | ataḥ prayogavidhireva svavidheyaprayogaprāśubhāvasidhdyarthaṃ niyataṃ kramamapi padārthaviśeṣaṇatayā - śruti, artha, pāṭha, sthāna, mukhya, pravṛttyā, khyāni | śrutilakṣaṇam tatra kramaparavacanaṃ śrutiḥ | tacca dvividham | kevalakramaparaṃ tadviśiṣṭapadārthaparaṃ ceti | tatra 'vedaṃ kṛtvā vedi karotīti kevalakramaparaṃ, vedikaraṇādervacanāntaraprāptatvāt | 'vaṣaṭakartuḥ prathamabhakṣaḥ iti tu kramaviśiṣṭapadārthaparam | ekaprasaratābhaṅgabhayena bhakṣānuvādena kramamātrasya vidhātumaśakyatvāt | śruteḥ kramabodhakapramāṇāntarebhyaḥ prābalyam seyaṃ śrutiritarapramāṇāpeśvayā balavatī teṣāṃ vacanakalpanadvārā kramapramāṇatvāt | ata evāśvinagrahaṇatya pāṭhakramātṛtīyasthāne grahaṇaprasakto 'āśvino daśamo gṛhyate' iti vacagāddaśamasthāne grahaṇamityuktam | arthakramaḥ yatra prayojanavaśena kramanirṇayaḥ so'rthakramaḥ | yathā - 'agnihotraṃ jahīti', yavāgū pacati ityagnihotrayavāgūpākayoḥ | atra hi yavāgvā homārthatvena tatpākaḥ prayojanavaśena pūrvamanuṣṭhīyate | sa cāyaṃ pāṭhakramādbalavān | yathāpāṭhaṃ hyanuṣṭhāne klṛptaprayojanabādhe'dṛṣṭā'tvaṃ ca syāt | paṭhitāni tenaiva krameṇādhītānyarthapratyayaṃ janayanti | yathāpratyayaṃ ca padārthānāmanuṣṭhānam | sa ca pāṭho dvividhaḥ - mantrapāṭho, brāhmaṇapāṭhaśceti | tatrāgneyāgnīṣomīyayostattadyājyanuvākyānāṃ pāṭhādyaḥ krama ādhīyate, sa mantrapāṭhāt | mantrapāṭho brāhmaṇapāṭhādvalīyān sa cāyaṃ mantrapāṭho brāhmaṇapāṭhādvalīyān, anuṣṭhāne brāhmaṇavākyāpestuyā tatkramasya ca mantrakramādhīnatvād antaraṅgo'yaṃ mantrapāṭha iti | brāhmaṇapāṭhakramāt kramaḥ prayājānāṃ samidho yajati, tanūnapātaṃ yajati ityevaṃ vidhipāṭhakramādyaḥ kramaḥ sa brāhmaṇapāṭhakramāt | yadyapi brāhāṇavākyānyarthaṃ vidhāya kṛtārthāni, tathāpi prayājādīnāṃ kramasmārakāntarasyābhāvāttānyeva kramasmārakatvena svokriyante| sthānalakṣaṇam sthānaṃ nāmopasthitiḥ | yasya hi deśe yo'nuṣṭhīyate tatpūrvatane padārthe kṛte sa eva prathamamupasthito bhavatīti yuktaṃ tasya prathamamanuṣṭhānam | ata eva sādyaske - agnīṣomīyasamavanīyānubandhānāṃ savanayi deśe sahānuṣṭhāne kartavye - ādau savanīyapaśoranuṣṭhānamitarayoḥ paścāt | tasmindeśe āśvinagrahaṇānantaraṃ savanīyasyaiva prathamamapasthitiḥ | sādyaskayāgaḥ tathāhi - jyotiṣṭome trayaḥ paśuyāgāḥ - agnīṣomoyaḥ, savanīyaḥ, ānubandhyaśceti | te ca bhinnadeśāḥ - agnīṣomīya aupavasathye'hni, savanīyaḥ sutyākāle, ānubandhyatkhante | sādyasko nāma somayāgaviśeṣaḥ | sa cāvyaktatvājyotiṣṭomavikāraḥ | ataste trayo'pi paśuyāgāḥ sādyaskreptāḥ| teṣāṃ tatra sāhityaṃ śrutaṃ 'saha paśūnālabheta' iti | tacca sāhityaṃ savanīyadeśe, tasya pradhānapratyāsatteḥ, sthānātikramagāsāmyācca| sthānātikramasāmyam savanīyaṭeśe hyanuṣṭhāne'noṣomīyānabandhyayoḥ svasvasthānātikramo bhavati | agnīṣomīyadeśe tvanuṣṭhāne savanīyasya svasthānātikramamātram| (agnīṣomīyasya savanīyasthānātikramaḥ|) ānubandhyasya tu svasthānātikramaḥ savanīyasthānātikramaśca syāt| evamanubandhyadeśe'gnīṣomīyasya draṣṭavyaḥ (sthānātikramaḥ)| savanīyasya prathamamanuṣṭhānam tathā ca savanīyadeśe sarveṣāmanuṣṭhāne kartavye savanīyasya prathamamanuṣṭhānam| āśvinagrahaṇānantaraṃ hi savanīyadeśaḥ| prakṛtau "āśvinaṃ gṛhaṃ gṛhītvā trivṛtā yūpaṃ parivīya āgneyaṃ savanīyaṃ paśumupākaroti" ityāśvinagrahaṇānantaraṃ savanīyo vihitaḥ - iti sādyaske'pyāśvinagrahaṇe kṛte savanīya evopasthito bhavati| ato yuktaṃ tasya sthānātpathamamanuṣṭhānam itarayostu paścāt - ityuktam| mukhyakramalakṣaṇam pradhānakrameṇa yo'ṅgānāṃ krama ādhīyate, sa mukhyakramaḥ | yena hi krameṇa pradhānāni kriyante tenaiva cet krameṇa teṣāmaṅgānyanuṣṭhīyante, tadā sarveṣāmaṅgānā svaiḥ svaiḥ pradhānaistulyaṃ vyavadhānaṃ bhavati | vyutkrameṇa tvanuṣṭhāne keṣāṃcidaṅgānāṃ svaiḥ pradhānaratyantamavyavadhānaṃ, keṣāṃcidatyanta vyavadhāna syāttaccāyuktaṃ, prayogavidhyavagatasāhityavādhāpatteḥ | ataḥ pradhānakramo'pyaṅgakrame hetuḥ | ata eva prayājaśeṣeṇādāvāgneyahaviṣo'bhidhāraṇaṃ, paścādaindrasya danaḥ, āgneyaindrayāgayoḥ paurvāparyāt | evaṃ ca dvayorabhighāraṇayoḥ svasvapradhānena tulyamekāntaritaṃ vyavadhānam | vyutkrameṇāghāre tvāgneyahavirabhighāraṇāgneyayāgayoratyantamavyavadhānam, aindradadhyabhidhāraṇaindrayāgayodyantarita vyavadhānaṃ, taccāyuktamityuktameva | mukhyakramasya pāṭhakramāddaurbalyam sa ca mukhyaḥ kramaḥ pāṭhakramādurbalaḥ | mukhyakramo hi pramāṇāntarasāpekṣapradhānakramapratipattisāpekṣatayā na tatheti balavān | tasya ca pravṛttikamāt prābalyam sa cāyaṃ mukhyaḥ kramaḥ pravṛttikramād balavān | pravṛttikrame hi bahūnāmaṅgānāṃ pradhānaviprakarṣāt mukhyakrame tu sannikarṣāt || pravṛttikramalakṣaṇam sahaprayujyamāneṣu pradhāneṣu sannipātināmaṅgānāmāvṛttyānuṣṭhāne karttavye hi dvitīyādipadārthānāṃ prathamānuṣṭhitapadārthakramādyaḥ kramaḥ sa pravṛttikramaḥ| yathā prājāpatyapaśvaṅgeṣu | prājāpatyā hi vaiśvadedī kṛtvā prājāpatyaiścarantīti vākyena tṛtīyānirdeśāt setikartavyatākā ekakālatvena vihitāḥ | atasteṣāṃ tadaṅgānāṃ copākaraṇaniyojanaprabhṛtīnāṃ sāhitya saṃpādyam | tacca prājāpatyapaśūnāṃ saṃpratipannadevatākatvena yugapadanuṣṭhānādupapadyate | tadaṅgānāṃ copākaraṇādīnāṃ yugapadanuṣṭhānamaśakyam | atasteṣāṃ sāhityamavyavahitānuṣṭhānātsaṃpādyam | taccaikasyopākaraṇaṃ vidhāyāparasyopākaraṇaṃ vidheyam | evaṃ niyojanāṭikamapi | tathā ca prājāpatyeṣu kasmāñcitpaśorārabhya eka sarvaṃ sarvatrānuṣṭhāya dvitīyādipadārthastenaiva krameṇānuṣṭheyaḥ - sa pravṛttikramaḥ | so'yaṃ śrutyādibhyo durbalaḥ | tadevaṃ saṃkṣepato nirūpitaḥ ṣaḍvidhakramanirūpaṇena prayogavidhiḥ || adhikāravidhilakṣaṇam karmajanyaphalasvāmyabodhako vidhiradhikāravidhiḥ | karmajanyaphalasvāmyaṃ karmajanyaphalabhoktṛratvam | sa ca 'yajeta svargakāma' ityādirūpaḥ | svargamuddiśya yāgaṃ vidadhatā'nena svargakāmasya yāgajanyaphalabhoktṛtvaṃ pratipādyate | 'yasyāhitāgneragnirgṛhān dahet so'gnaye kṣāmavate'ṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapet ityādinā'gnidāhādau nimitte karma vidadhatā nimittavataḥ karmajanyapāpakṣayarūpaphalasvāmyaṃ pratipādyate | evaṃ 'aharahaḥ sandhyāmapāsīta' ityādinā śucivihitakālajīvinaḥ sandhyopāsanajanyapratyavāyaparihārarūpaphalasvāmyaṃ bodhyate | adhikārasvarūpam (śrutam) tacca phalasvāmyaṃ tasyaiva yo'dhikāraviśiṣṭaḥ | adhikāraśca sa yadvidhivākyeṣu puruṣaviśeṣaṇatvena śrūyate | yathā kāmye karmaṇi phalakāmanā, naimitteke karmaṇi nimittaniścayaḥ, nitye saṃdhyopāsanādau śucivihitakālajīvitvam | ata eva 'rājā rājasūyena svārājyakāmo yajeta' ityanena vidhivākyana svārājyamuddiśya vidadhatā'pi na svārājyamātrakāmasya tatphalabhoktatvaṃ pratipādyate, kiṃ tu rājñaḥ sataḥ svārājyakāmasyaiva, rājatvasyāpi'pyadhikāriviśeṣaṇatvena śravaṇāt | puruṣaviśeṣaṇam (aśrutam) kvacittu puruṣaviśeṣaṇatvenāśrutamapyadhikāriviśeṣaṇam | yathādhyayanavidhisiddhā vidyā, kratūvidhīnāmarśajñānāpekṣatvenādhyayanavidhisiddhārthajñānavantaṃ pratyeva pravṛtteḥ | evamagnisādhyakarmasu ādhānasiddhāgnimattā| agnisādhyakarmaṇāmagnyapekṣatvena tadvidhonāmādhānasiddhāgnimantaṃ pratyeva pravṛtteḥ | evaṃ sāmarthyamapi 'ākhyātānāmarthaṃ bruvatāṃ śaktiḥ sahakāriṇī' iti nyāyāt samarthaṃ pratyeva vidhipravṛtteḥ | tadevaṃ nirūpitau vidhiḥ || caturtho mantraparicchedaḥ mantramīmāṃsā prayogasamavetārthasmārakā mantrāḥ| teṣāṃ ca tādṛśārthasmārakatvenaivārthavattvam | na tu taduccāraṇamadṛṣṭārtham, saṃbhavati dṛṣṭaphalakatva'dṛṣṭaphalakalpanāyā anyāyyatvāt |na ca - dṛṣṭasyārthasmaraṇasya prakārāntareṇāpi saṃbhavānmantrānānaṃ vyartham - iti vācyam | 'mantraireva smartavyam' iti - niyamavidhyāśrayaṇāt| saṃpratipannadevatākatvena yugapadanuṣṭhānādupapadyate | niyamavidhiḥ nānāsādhanasādhyakriyāyāmekasādhanaprāptāvaprāptasyāparasādhanasya prāpako vidhiniyamavidhiḥ | yathāhuḥ - 'vidhiratyantamaprāptau niyamaḥ pākṣike sati | tatra cānyatra ca prāptau parisaṃkhyeti gīyate || iti | asyārthaḥ - pramāṇāntareṇāprāptasya prāpako vidhirapūrvavidhiḥ | yathā - 'yajeta svargakāma ' ityādiḥ | svargārthakayāgasya pramāṇāntareṇāprāptasyānena vidhānāt | pakṣeprāptasya prāpako vidhiniyamavidhiḥ | yathā - 'brīhīnabahanti' inyādiḥ | kathamasya pakṣeprāptaprāpakatvam ? iti cet, ittham - anena hyavadhātasya vaituṣyārthatvaṃ na pratipādyate, anvayavyatirekasiddhatvāt | kiṃtu niyamaḥ | sa cāprāptāṃśapūraṇam | vaituṣyasya hi nānopāyasādhyatvādyadā avadhānaṃ parityajya upāyāntaraṃ grahītumārabhate, tadāvaghātasyāprāptatvana tadvidhānanāmakamaprāptāṃśapūraṇamevānena vidhinā kriyate | ataśca niyamavidhāvaprāptāṃśapūraṇātmako niyama eva vākyārthaḥ | pakṣeprāptāvaghātasya vidhānamiti yāvat | parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ ubhayośca yugapatprāptāvitaravyāvṛttiparo vidhiḥ parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ | yathā - 'pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' iti | idaṃ hi vākyaṃ na pañcapañcanakhabhakṣaṇapara, tasya rāgataḥ prāptatvāt | nāpi niyamaparaṃ, pañcapañcanakhapaścetarapañcanakhabhakṣaṇasya yugapatprāpteḥ pakṣeprāptyabhāvāt | ata idamapañcapañcanakhabhakṣaṇanivṛttiparamiti bhavati parisaṃkhyāvidhiḥ | parisaṃkhyā dvividhā sā ca dvividhā - śrautī lākṣaṇikī ceti | tatra 'atra hyevāvayantīti śrautī parisaṃkhyā | evakāreṇa pavamānātiriktastotravyāvṛtterabhidhānāt | 'pañca pañcanakhā bhakṣyāḥ' iti tu lākṣaṇikī| parisaṃkhyāyā doṣatrayam doṣatrayaṃ ca - śrutahāniḥ, aśratakalpanā, prāptabādhaśceti | taduktam - 'śrutārthasya parityāgādaśrutārthaprakalpanāt | prāptasya bādhādityevaṃ parisaṃkhyā tridūṣaṇā ||' iti | śrutasya pañcapañcanakhabhakṣaṇasya hānāt, aśrutāyā apañcapañcanakhabhakṣaṇanivṛtteḥ kalpanātprāptasya cāpañcapañcanakhabhaśaṇasya bādhanāditi | asmiṃśca doṣatrayaṃ doṣadvayaṃ śabdaniṣṭham | prāptavādhastvarthaniṣṭha iti dik | keṣāṃcinmantrāṇāmuccāraṇamadṛṣṭārtham yeṣāṃ tu prayogasamavetārthasmārakatvaṃ na saṃbhavati, taduccāraṇasyānanyagatyā 'dṛṣṭārthakatvaṃ kalpyate iti nānarthakyamiti || pañcamo nāmadheyayaparicchedaḥ nāmadheyamīmāṃsā nāmadheyānāṃ ca vidheyārthaparicchedakatayārthavattvam | tathā hi 'udbhidā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ityatrodbhicchabdo yāganāmadheyaṃ, tena ca vidheyārthaparicchedaḥ kriyate | tathā hi | anena vākyenāprāptatvāt phaloddeśena yāgo vidhīyate | yāgasāmānyasyāvidheyatvād yāgaviśeṣa eva vidhīyate | tatra 'ko'sau yāgaviśeṣaḥ' ? ityapekṣāyāmadbhicchabdādudbhidrūpo yāga iti jñāyate | 'udbhidā yāgena paśuṃ bhāvayet' - ityatra sāmānādhikaraṇyena nāmadheyānvayāt nāmadheyatve nimittacatuṣṭayam nāmadheyatvaṃ ca nimittacatuṣṭayāt - matvarthalakṣaṇābhayāt, vākyabhedabhayāt, tatprakhyaśāstrāt, tavyapadeśāt - ceti| matvarthalakṣaṇābhayāt nāmadheyatvaṃ | tatra 'udbhidā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ityatrodbhicchabdasya yāganāmadheyatvaṃ matvarthalakṣaṇābhayāt | tathā hi - na tāvadanena vākyena phalaṃ prati yāgavidhāna, taṃ prati ca guṇavidhānaṃ yujyate, vākyabhedāpatteḥ | udbhicchabdasya guṇasamarpakatve ca yāgasyāpyaprāptatvāt guṇaviśiṣṭakarmavidhānaṃ vācyam | 'udbhidvatā yāgena paśuṃ bhāvaye diti viśiṣṭavidhau matvarthalakṣaṇetyuktameva || vākyabhedabhayāt nāmadheyatvaṃ | "citrayā yajeta paśukāmaḥ' ityatra citrāśabdasya karmanāmadheyatvaṃ vākyabheḍhabhayāt | tathā hi - na tāvadatra guṇaviśiṣṭayāgavidhānaṃ saṃbhavati | 'dadhi madhu payo ghṛtaṃ dhānā udakaṃ taṇḍulāḥ tatsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ prājāpatyama', ityanena guṇasya vihitatvāttadviśiṣṭayāgavidhyanupapatteḥ | yāgasya phalasaṃbamdhe guṇasambandhe ca vidhīyamāne vākyabhedaḥ | tasmāccitrāśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyam | tathā ca 'citrāyāgena paśuṃ bhāvaye diti sāmānādhikaraṇyenānvayānna vākyabhedaḥ | prakṛteṣṭeranekadravyatvena citrāśabdavācyatvopapattiḥ | tatprakhyaśāstrāt nāmadheyatvaṃ | 'agnihotraṃ juhoti' ityatrāgnihotraśabdasya karmanāmadheyatvaṃ, tatprakhyaśākhāt | tasya guṇasya prakhyāpakasyaprāpakasya śāstrasya vidyamānatvāt, agnihotraśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyamiti yāvat | nanvayaṃ guṇavidhireva kuto ne iti cet na| yadi 'agnau hotramasmin', iti saptamīsamāsamāśritya homādhāratvenāgnirūpo guṇo vidheyaḥ, tadā 'yadāhavanīye juhotī tyanenaivāgneḥ prāptatvāttadvidhānānarthakyam | 'agnaye hotramiti caturthīsamāsamāśritya agnidevatārūpaguṇo'nena vidhīyata iti cet na | taddevatāyāḥ śāstrāntareṇa prāptatvāt| devatārūpeṇāgniprāpakaśāstrapraśnaḥ| kiṃ tacchākhāntarami?ti cet, 'yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' iti kecit apare tu 'agniytiryotiranissvāhā' iti mantravarṇa evāgnirūpadevatāprāpakaḥ | nanvanermāntravarṇikatve prajāpatidevatāyā bādhaḥ syāt | mantravarṇasya caturthīto durbalatvāt | yathāhuḥ 'taddhitena caturthyā ca mantravaṇerna vā punaḥ | devatāyā vidhistatra durbalaṃ tu paraparamiti || iti cet, na| 'yadagnaye ca prajāpataye ca sāyaṃ juhoti' ityatra na kevala prajāpatividhānaṃ kiṃtu mantravarṇaprāptamagnimanudya tatsamuccitaprajāpateḥ | evaṃ ca na bādhaḥ, kevalaprajāpatividhānābhāvāt | na ca atra samuccitobhayavidhānameva kathaṃ na? iti vācyam | samucitobhayavidhānāpekṣayānyataḥ prāptamagnimanūdya tatsamuccitaprajāpatimātravidhāne lāghavāt | evaṃ ca prayājeṣu samidādidevatānāṃ 'samidhaḥ samidho agna ājyasya vyantu ityādimantravarṇebhyaḥ prāptatvāta | 'samidho yajati ityādiṣu samidādiśabdāḥ 'tatprakhyaśāstrāt' karmanāmadheyāḥ || tadvyapadeśāt nāmadheyatvaṃ | 'śyenenābhicaran yajeta' ityatra śyenaśabdasya karmanāmadheyatvaṃ tadyapadeśāt' | tena vyapadeśāt - upamānāt, tadanyathānupapatteriti yāvat | tathā hi - yadvidheyaṃ tasya stutirbhavati | yadyatra śyeno vidheyaḥ syāt tadārthavādastasyaiva stutiḥ kāryā | atra 'yathā vai śyeno nipatyādatte, evamayaṃ dviṣantaṃ bhrātṛvyaṃ nipatyādate ityanenārthavādena śyenaḥ stotuṃ na śakyaḥ, śyenopamānenārthāntarastuteḥ kriyamāṇatvāt | na ca śyenopamānatvena sa eva stotuṃ śakyate, upamānopameyabhāvasya bhinnaniṣṭhatvāt | yadā tu śyenasaṃjñako yāgo vidhīyate, tadā arthavādena śyenopamānena tasya stutiḥ kartuṃ śakyate - iti śyenaśabdaḥ karmanāmadheyaṃ tadvyapadeśāt iti| utpattiśiṣṭaguṇabalīyastvāt karmanāmadheyatvam| utpattiśiṣṭaguṇabalayistvamapi pañcamaṃ nāmadheyanimittamiti kacit | yathā 'vaiśvadevena yajeta' ityādau | atrotpattiśiṣṭāgnyāṭīnāṃ balīyasvādvaiśvadevadevatāvidhāyakatvaṃ na saṃbhavatīti karmanāmadheyatvam | vastutastu 'tatprakhyaśāstrāt' evāsya karmanāmadheyatvaṃ, prakṛtayāge viśvedevarūpagupāmarpakaśāstrasyārthavādarūpasyaiva sattvāt | 'yadviśvedevāḥ samayajanta tadvaiśvadevasya vaiśvadevatvam iti|| ṣaṣṭho niṣedhaparicchedaḥ niṣedhamīmāṃsā puruṣasya nivartakaṃ vākyaṃ niṣedhaḥ, niṣedhavākyānāmanarthahetukriyānivṛttijanakatvenaivārthavattvāt | tathā hi - yathā vidhiḥ pravartanāṃ pratipādayan svapravartakatvanirvāhārthaṃ vidheyasya yāgāderiṣṭasādhanatvamākṣipan puruṣaṃ tatra pravartayati, tathā 'na kalaja bhakṣayet' ityādiniṣedho'pi nivartanāṃ pratipādayan svanivartakatvanirvāhārthaṃ niṣedhyasya kalañjabhakṣaṇasya parāniṣṭasādhanatvamākṣipan puruṣaṃ tato nivartayati| liyaśabdabhāvanāyā nagarthenānvayaḥ nanu niṣedhavākyasya kathaṃ nivarttanāpratipādakatvam iti cet ucyate | na tāvadatra dhātvarthasya nārthenānvayaḥ, avyavadhāne'pi tasya pratyayārthabhāvanopasarjanatvenopasthiteḥ | na hyanyopasarjanatvenopasthitamanyatrānveti | anyathā 'rājapuruṣamānaya ityādāvapi rājñaḥ kriyānvayāpatteḥ | ataḥ pratyayārthasyaiva narthenānvayaḥ | tatrāpi nākhyātatvāṃśavācyārthabhāvanāyāḥ, tasyā liṅtvāṃśavācyapravartanopasarjanatvenopasthiteḥ, kiṃtu liṅtvāṃśavāśabdabhāvanāyāḥ, tasyāḥ sarvāpekṣayā pradhānatvāt| nasvabhāvakathanam natraścaiṣa svabhāvo yatsvamamabhivyāhṛtapadārthavirodhibodhakatvam | yathā 'ghaṭo nāsti' ityādau 'asti' itiśabdasamabhivyāhṛto 'nañ ghaṭasattvavirodhi ghaṭāsattvaṃ gamayati, ta(da)diha liṅamamabhivyāhṛto nañ liṅarthapravartanāvirādhinīṃ nivartanāmeva bodhayati | vidhivākyaśravāṇe'yaṃ māṃ pravartayatīti pravartanāpratītivat niṣedhavākyaśravaṇe'yaṃ māṃ nivartayatīti nivṛttyanukūlavyāpārarūpanivartanāyāḥ pratīteḥ| tasmānniṣedhavākyasthale nivartanaiva vākyārthaḥ| pratyayarthāsya navaryānvaye dvividhaṃ bādhakam yadā tu pratyayārthasya tatrānvaye bādhakaṃ tadā dhātvarthasyaiva tatrānvayaḥ | tacca bādhakaṃ dvividhama – 'tasya vratam ' ityupakramaḥ, vikalpaprasaktiśca tatrādyaṃ 'nekṣetodyantamādityam' ityādau, 'tasya vratam' ityupakamyaitadvākyapāṭhāt | tathā cātra paryudāsāśrayaṇam | tathāhi - vrataśabdasya kartavyārthe rūḍhatvāt 'tasya vratam' ityatra snātakasya vratānāṃ karttavyatvenopakramāt | kiṃ tatkartavyam ?' ityākāṅkṣāyāṃ 'nekṣetodyantam' ityādinā karttavyārtha eva pratipādanīyaḥ | anyathā parvottaravākyayorekavākyatvaṃ na syāta | tathā ca narthena na pratyayārthānvayaḥ, kartavyārthānababodhāt| vidhyarthapravartanāvirodhinivartanāyā eva tādṛśananā bodhanāt, tasyāśca kartavyārthatvābhāvāt | tasmāt 'nekṣete' ityatra natrā dhātvarthavirādhyanīkṣaṇasaṃkalpa eva lakṣaṇayā pratipādyate, tasya karttavyatvasaṃbhavāt | paryudāsapakṣe 'nekṣeta' ityasya vākyārthaḥ 'ādityaviṣayakānīkṣaṇasaṃkalpena bhāvayet' iti vākyārthaḥ | tatra bhāvyākāṅkṣāyāṃ 'etāvatā hainamā viyukto bhavati iti vākyaśeṣāvagataḥ pāpakṣayo bhāvyatayānveti | evaṃ ca pūrvotarayorekavākyatvaṃ nirvahatyeva | na cātra dhātvarthabirodhina paṭārthāntarasyāpi saṃbhavātkathamanīkṣaṇasaṃkalpasyaiva bhāvanānvaya iti vācyam | tasya karttavyatā'bhāvena prakṛte bhāvanānvayāyogyatvāt | vikalpaprasaktau paryudāsāśrayaṇam dvitīyaṃ – 'yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti nānuyājeṣu' ityārdī atra vikalpaprasaktau ca paryudāsāśrayaṇāt | tathāhi - yadyatra vākye natrarthe pratyayārthānvayaḥ syāttadā anuyājeṣu 'ye yajāmahe' iti mantrasya pratiṣedhaḥ syāt - anuyājeṣu yeyajāmahaṃ na kuryāditi | sa ca prāptipūrvaka eva, prāptasyaiva pratiṣedhāt | prāptiśca yajatiṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti' iti śāstradeva vācyā śāstraprāptasya ca pratiṣedhe vikalpa eva, na tu bādhaḥ | prāptimūlarāgasyeva tanmūlaśāsrasya śāstrāntareṇa bādhāyogāt | naca 'pade juhoti' iti viśeṣaśāstreṇa 'āhavanīye juhoti iti śāsrasyeva 'nānuyājeṣu' ityanena 'yajatiṣu ye yajāmahaṃ karoti' ityasya bādhaḥ syāditi vācyam | parasparanirapekṣayoreva śāstrayorbādhyabādhakabhāvāt | padaśāstrasya hi svārthavidhānārthamāhavanīyaśāsrānapekṣaṇānnirapekṣatvam | prakṛte tu niṣedhaśāstrasya niṣedhyapramaktyarthaṃ 'yajatiṣu ye yajāmaham' ityasyāpekṣaṇāt nirapekṣatvam | bādhāyogopasaṃhāraḥ tasmācchāsravihitasya śākhāntareṇa pratiṣedhe vikalpa eva | sa ca na yuktaḥ | vikalpe śāstrasya pākṣikāprāmāṇyāpātāt | nahi anuyājeṣu 'ye yajāmaham' ityasyānuṣṭhāne 'nānuyājeṣu ityasya prāmāṇyaṃ saṃbhavati, vrīhiyāgānuṣṭhāne yavaśāsrasyeva | dviradṛṣṭakalapanā ca syāt | vidhipratiṣedhayorapi puruṣārthatvāt | ato nātra pratiṣedhasyāśrayaṇaṃ, kiṃtu naño'nuyājasaṃbandhamāśritya paryudāsasyaiva | itthaṃ cānuyājavyatirikteṣu 'yajatiṣu ye yajāmahe' iti mantraṃ kuryāditi vākyārthabodhaḥ, natro'nuyājavyatirikte lākṣaṇikatvāt | evaṃ ca na vikalpaḥ| atra ca vākye 'ye yajāmahe' iti na vidhoyate, 'yajatiṣu yeyajāmaham' ityanenaiva ca prāptatvāt | kiṃ tu sāmānyaśāstraprāpta - yeyajāmaha ityanuvādena tasyānuyājavyatiriktaviṣayatvaṃ vidhīyate | yat 'yajāteṣu yeyajāmahaṃ karoti' tadanuyājavyatirikteṣvevati | paryudāsopasaṃhārayorbhedavarṇanam nanvevaṃ sāmānyaśāstraprāptasya viśeṣe saṃkocanarūpādupasaṃhārātparyudāsasya bhedo na syāditi cet, na | upasaṃhāro hi tanmātrasaṃkocārthaḥ | yathā 'puroḍāśaṃ caturdhākaroti' iti samānyaprāptaṃ caturdhākaraṇaṃ āgneyaṃ caturdhākaroti' iti vigeṣādāgneyapuroḍāśamātre saṃkocyate | paryudāsasya tadanyamātrasaṃkocārtha iti tato bhedāt | vikalpaprasaktāvapi pratiṣedhāśrayaṇam kutracidvikalpapramaktāvapyananyagatyā pratiṣedhāśrayaṇam | yathā 'nātirāce ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti ityādau | atra hi atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti śāsraprāptaṣoḍaśigrahaṇasya niṣedhādvikalpaprasaktāvapi na paryudāsāśrayaṇam, asaṃbhavāt | tathāhi - yadyatra ṣoḍaśipadārthena natrarthānvayaḥ, tadātirātre ṣoḍaśivyatiriktaṃ gṛhṇātīti vākyārthabodhaḥ syāt, sa ca na saṃbhavati, 'atirātre ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti pratyakṣavidhivirodhāt | yadi cātirātreṇa padārthenānvayaḥ, tadā 'atirātravyatirikte ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇāti' iti vākyārthabodhaḥ syātso'pi na saṃbhavati, tadvidhivirodhāt | ato'trānanyagatyā śāstraprāptaṣoḍaśigrahaṇasyaiva niṣedhaḥ | na ca vikalpaprasaktiḥ, tasyāpyapekṣaṇītvāt | vikalpe pratiṣidhyamānasyānarthahetutvābhāvavarṇanam iyāṃstu viśeṣaḥ - yadvikalpāpādakapratiṣedhe'pi pratiṣidhyamānasya nānarthahenatvam, vidhiniṣedhobhayasyāpi kratvarthatvāt | yatra tu na vikalpaḥ prāptiśca rāgata eva, pratiṣedhaśca puruṣārthaḥ, tatra pratiṣidhyamānasyānarthahetutvam | yathā - 'na kalaṅgaṃ bhakṣayet ityādau kalañjabhakṣaṇādeḥ | tatra bhakṣaṇaniṣedhasyaiva puruṣārthatvāt | na ca 'dīkṣito na dadāti, na juddoti' ityādau śāstraprāptadānahomādīnāṃ niṣedhādvikalpāpattiriti vācyam | svataḥ puruṣārthabhūtadānahomādīnāṃ niṣedhasya puruṣārthatvābhāve'pi niṣidhyamānasyānarthahetutvāt,yathā kratau svasrīgamanādeḥ | tanniṣedhasya kratvarthatvena tasya kratuvaiguṇyasaṃpādakatvāt || saptamo'rthavādaparicchedaḥ arthavādamīmāṃsā prāśastyanindānyataraparaṃ vākyamarthavādaḥ | tasya ca lakṣaṇayā prayojanavadarthaparyavasānam | tathā hi - arthavādavākyaṃ hi svārthapratipādane prayojanābhāvādvidheyaniṣedhyayoḥ prāśasyaninditatve lakṣaṇayā pratipādayati | svārthamātraparatve ānarthakyaprasaṅgāt | 'āmnāyasya hi kriyārthatvāt | na ceṣṭāpattiḥ | 'svādhyāyo'dhyetavyaḥ' ityadhyayanavidhinā sakalavedādhyayanaṃ karttavyamiti bodhayatā sarvavedasya prayojanavadarthaparyavasāyitvaṃ sūcayatopāttatvenānarthaktanupapatteḥ | arthavādavibhāgaḥ sa dvividhaḥ - vidhiśeṣaḥ, niṣedhaśeṣaśceti | tatra 'vāyavyaṃ śvetamālabheta bhūtikāmaḥ' ityādividhiśeṣasya 'vāyurvai kṣepiṣṭhā devatā' ityādevidheyārthaprāśastyabodhakatayārthavattvam | 'barhiṣi rajataṃ na deyam ityādiniṣedhaśeṣasya, so'rodīdyadarodīttidrudrasya rudratvam ityāderniṣadhasya, ninditatvabodhakatayārthavattvam | na ca prāśasyādibodhasya niṣprayojanatvenasyārthavattvamiti vācyam | ālasyādivaśādapravartamānasya puṃsaḥ pravṛttvādijanakatvena tadvodhasyopayogāt| arthavādasya bhedatrayam sa punasradhā - taduktam| 'virodha guṇavādaḥ syādanuvādo'vadhārite| bhūtārthavādastaddhānādarthavādanidhā mataḥ' iti | asyārthaḥ - pramāṇāntaravirodhe satyarthavādaḥ guṇavādaḥ, yathā 'ādityo yūpaḥ' ityādi | yape ādityābhedasya pratyakṣabādhitatvādādityavadujjalatvarūpaguṇo'nena lakṣaṇayā pratipādyate| pramāṇāntarāvagatārthabodhako'nuvādaḥ anuvādaḥ, yathā - 'agnirhimasya bheṣajam' iti | atra himavirodhitvasyāgnau pratyakṣāvagatatvāt | pramāṇāntaravirodhatatprāptirahitārthabodhako'rthavādaḥ | bhūtārthavādaḥ| yathā - 'indro vṛtrāya vajramudayacchat ityādiḥ| aṣṭamo nigamanaparicchedaḥ graṃthopasaṃhāraḥ evaṃ ca yajeta svargakāmaḥ' ityādinikhilavedasya sākṣātparaṃparayā vā yāgādidharmapratipādakatvaṃ siddham | so'yaṃ dharmo yaduddiśya vihitaḥ, taduddeśena kriyamāṇastaddhetuḥ | īśvarārpaṇabuddhyā kriyamāṇastu niḥśreyasahetuḥ | na ca tadarpaṇabuddhyānaṣṭhāne pramāṇābhāvaḥ - 'yatkaroṣi yadanāsi yajjuhoṣi dadāsi yat| yattapasyasi kaunteya tatkuruṣva madarpaṇam || iti bhagavadgītāsmṛtereva pramāṇatvāt | smṛticaraṇe tatprāmāṇyasya śrutimalakatvena vyavasthāpanāditi śivam || arthasaṃgrahaprayojanam bālānāṃ sukhabodhāya bhāskareṇa sumedhasā| racito'yaṃ samāsena jaiminīyārthasaṃgrahaḥ || iti dhāmahāpāścāganogākṣibhāskaraniracinapūrvamaimāsārthasaṃgrahanāmakaṃ prakaraṇaṃ samāptimagāta ||
